newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares seen extending gains.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares seen extending gains.

text.p: Chilean blue chips were expected to extend Monday's strong gains on confidence in the telecommunciations, electrical and retail sectors, brokers said.
The blue-chip IPSA index ended at 133.62 points on Monday, up 1.57 percent for the day, while the all-share IGPA gained 0.64 percent to 5768.87 points.

Investors are counting on strong second quarter earnings reports to be released at the end of the month and were expecting a new influx of foreign buying, not just in Chile but in most major Latin American bourses.

The bourse was also waiting to see June and first-half inflation figures and quarterly unemployment numbers due to be released by the National Statistics Institute on Tuesday at about 1030 EDT/1430 GMT.
